notes: quarterly DPS (declared): 5 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2018-12-31: 0.33 (filed 2019-02-28) used, not 1.32 (filed 2020-02-28) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide); 2019-12-31: 0.33 (filed 2020-02-28) used, not 1.32 (filed 2021-02-26) — the value the year-to-date facts give (2019-01-01..2019-12-31 − 2019-01-01..2019-09-30); 2023-06-30: 0.3 (filed 2023-07-27) used, not 0.6 (filed 2024-08-09) — the value the year-to-date facts give (2023-01-01..2023-06-30 − 2023-01-01..2023-03-31); 2023-09-30: 0.3 (filed 2023-10-26) used, not 0.9 (filed 2024-11-12) — the value the year-to-date facts give (2023-01-01..2023-09-30 − 2023-01-01..2023-06-30); 2024-06-30: 0.3 (filed 2024-08-09) used, not 0.6 (filed 2025-07-31) — the value the year-to-date facts give (2024-01-01..2024-06-30 − 2024-01-01..2024-03-31)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

annual_dps: the declared FY DPS fact for the period ended 2015-12-31 (0.48) is below the sum of the same tag's quarterly facts inside that fiscal year (0.81: 2015-06-30: 0.15, 2015-09-30: 0.33, 2015-12-31: 0.33) — the quarters are not borne out by year-to-date facts (one of those filings is mis-tagged) and no other filed full-year total replaces it, so the FY fact is kept as filed

annual_dps: the declared FY DPS fact for the period ended 2018-12-31 (0.33) is below the sum of the same tag's quarterly facts inside that fiscal year (1.32: 2018-03-31: 0.33, 2018-06-30: 0.33, 2018-09-30: 0.33, 2018-12-31: 0.33), and those quarters are borne out by the tag's year-to-date facts or each equal the FY value (one quarter's rate tagged with the full-year context) — the full-year fact is not a total and is not used (the year has an annual row only if its four quarterly facts are filed)

annual_dps: the declared FY DPS fact for the period ended 2019-12-31 (0.33) is below the sum of the same tag's quarterly facts inside that fiscal year (1.32: 2019-03-31: 0.33, 2019-06-30: 0.33, 2019-09-30: 0.33, 2019-12-31: 0.33), and those quarters are borne out by the tag's year-to-date facts or each equal the FY value (one quarter's rate tagged with the full-year context) — the full-year fact is not a total and is not used (the year has an annual row only if its four quarterly facts are filed)
annual_dps: FY2018, FY2019 = sum of the four filed quarterly DPS facts (no FY fact)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 1.35 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.45, 2026-06-30: 0.5) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.3, 2025-06-30: 0.3)

buybacks_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed buybacks figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30) — the tag was never filed in any period, so the leg counts as zero
share_issuance_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed share_issuance figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)
